items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had my manager, Karen, reach Shankar, Anoushka Shankar.

ctx.x: But it will expand your tonal palatte. You’ll hear those sonorities.

Exactly. Then you’ll say, how can I use those sounds in my own stuff? That’s what it’s about. How can I utilize those sounds? Sitar. At one point I had my manager – because, speaking about projects, I had my manager, Karen, reach Shankar, Anoushka Shankar. She did reach her, but she was busy.
She was touring with the Pops.
